header: Three weeks from signed contract to go-live
subheadline: A Growth customer sees each milestone and due date in their own portal from day one. The median go-live across 1,340 companies is 17 days.

slides.title: Week one: kickoff and data
slides.lead: A 45-minute call, an agreed go-live date and a named owner on each side.
slides.description: Week one starts with the data import and three decisions: who signs off, which systems connect and what go-live means for this customer.

slides.title: Week two: configuration
slides.lead: Your team sets up the account while the customer completes their tasks.
slides.description: Each open question is a task with a due date and an automatic reminder. Nobody chases a missing tax ID by email.

slides.title: Week three: go-live and handover
slides.lead: The account moves to your support team with its full history.
slides.description: Go-live closes the plan and exports the timeline, with every decision recorded. Support knows what was agreed in week one before the first ticket.
